title: The Day of Two Identical Hats
skyStory: The crescent moon has drifted into Aquarius and is wearing a lab coat now, scribbling equations about probability on the clouds. Thirteen percent lit and fully nerdy. Uranus slides it a note: run the experiment on those two. The moon grins, flips a cosmic coin, and arranges for the same ridiculous object to cross both of their paths before supper. The coin lands on its edge.

reading: Something very specific is coming: a knitted hat with an absurdly large orange pompom. You will see it on a stranger, a sign, or a screen, probably around 1:30 pm. Take note of where. This is not random. The moon is conducting an experiment and you are the control group.

Here is the twist. Nancy is getting the same hat in her day. When you compare notes tonight, you will both say the same word at once. Do not even scream. It is the universe showing off its sense of humour and reminding you that the thread between the cabin and the shore is real, thick, and occasionally wears a pompom.
joel.mission: Text Nancy a single emoji tonight that describes the strangest thing you saw today, then wait for hers before saying anything.
joel.omen: An orange pompom, anywhere. It means the moon is running tests and you have passed the first one.

reading: Your intuition is set to maximum today, Life Path 11. You will know who is calling before you look, guess the next song before it plays, and possibly predict what someone orders at a counter. Do not tell anyone. Just smile like the wise old Wood Rat you are.

Then the big one: an orange pompom, ridiculous and proud, will cross your path in the afternoon. Joel is being sent the same one. When you find out, the correct response is ΔΕΣ, said with your hands as large as possible. The [[Wheel of Fortune]] does not spin for nothing, and today it spun specifically to make you both laugh at the same time.
nancy.mission: Guess three small things before they happen today, like the colour of the next car, and keep secret score on your hand.
nancy.omen: The same number on two receipts or clocks. It means your intuition is right on schedule, so trust your next hunch.
nancy.stoneWhy: his stone hears the joke too

together.text: Tonight, compare days. Somewhere in there is an orange pompom, and when you both find it, say DES out loud together on the count of three. Then write down the time it happened. The universe likes to know its jokes landed.
